activeVertexStream.encoding: 16 vertices, eight little-endian binary32 values per vertex: position float4, SDF float2, source float2
activeVertexStream.constructionStatus: independently generated and already verified byte-for-byte against the active bytes of Apple's retained sample-28 vertex stream

indexStream.encoding: 24 little-endian uint16 indices forming four independent quads and eight triangles

independentAxis.encoding: 8 by 1024 RGBA32Uint; one row per primitive; SDF-x and SDF-y are populated and the pixel-irrelevant source lanes are zero
independentAxis.selector: authenticated base fractional-selector table with offset zero

nativeProbe.platform: physical Retina M1 Max running macOS 26.6.1 build 25G76
nativeProbe.toolchain: Apple xcrun swiftc and runtime Metal compilation; executable must contain no Nix-store path
nativeProbe.vertexStage: diagnostic source vertex stage applying the exact power-of-two 1024-pixel orthographic transform to the frozen active vertex attributes
nativeProbe.fragmentStage: serialize interpolate_at_center, dfdx, dfdy, and primitive_id without invoking Liquid Glass color arithmetic
nativeProbe.classification: AGX fixed-function raster diagnostic; not an Apple shader or final-image oracle

decision.centerExact: If every rasterized pixel-influential SDF center word equals the independent axis reconstruction for the native primitive owner, classify the seven-byte frame residual as downstream derivative, coverage, or attachment arithmetic. The serialized source coordinates are a nonvacuous control and are not compared to the intentionally zero source lanes in the product axis.
decision.centerResidual: If any center word differs, isolate the first primitive, component, coordinate, tile, and selector term before changing the constructor.
decision.coverageResidual: If primitive ownership or covered sample centers differ, isolate raster coverage separately from interpolant arithmetic.
decision.derivativeUse: Derivative words may discriminate the downstream branch but may not be used as captured product inputs.
